connector.name: getMe MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: An MCP server that exposes getMe key-value operations as MCP tools
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package getme-mcp-server. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the aatirnadim account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: GETME_SOCKET_PATH
env.description: Path to the UNIX socket for getMe core server

env.name: GETME_READ_ONLY
env.description: If true, only get and get_json tools are registered

env.name: GETME_ALLOW_CLEAR
env.description: If true, enables the dangerous clear tool

env.name: GETME_KEY_PREFIX
env.description: String prefix prepended to all keys (e.g. agent1:)
